sentences.en: An airborne reintroduction programme has helped conservationists take significant steps to protect the endangered Galápagos tortoise.
sentences.zh: 空中放归计划帮助自然资源保护者采取重大措施来保护濒临灭绝的加拉帕戈斯象龟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A. Forests of spiny cacti cover much of the uneven lava plains that separate the interior of the Galapagos island of Isabela from the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: A. 多刺仙人掌森林覆盖了大部分不平坦的熔岩平原,这些平原将加拉帕戈斯伊莎贝拉岛的内部与太平洋分开。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: With its five distinct volcanoes, the island resembles a lunar landscape.
sentences.zh: 该岛拥有五座独特的火山,类似于月球景观。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Only the thick vegetation at the skirt of the often cloud-covered peak of Sierra Negra offers respite from the barren terrain below.
sentences.zh: 只有内格拉山脉经常被云层覆盖的山峰边缘茂密的植被为下面贫瘠的地形提供了喘息的机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This inhospitable environment is home to the giant Galápagos tortoise.
sentences.zh: 这个荒凉的环境是巨型加拉帕戈斯象龟的家园。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sometime after the Galápagos's birth, around five million Sala years ago, the islands were colonised by one or more tortoises from mainland South America.
sentences.zh: 加拉帕戈斯群岛诞生后的某个时间,大约五百万萨拉年前,这些岛屿被来自南美洲大陆的一只或多只陆龟殖民。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: As these ancestral tortoises settled on the individual islands, the different populations adapted to their unique environments, giving rise to at least 14 different subspecies.
sentences.zh: 当这些陆龟祖先定居在各个岛屿上时,不同的种群适应了它们独特的环境,产生了至少 14 个不同的亚种。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Island life agreed with them.
sentences.zh: 岛上的生活也同意他们的看法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the absence of significant predators, they grew to become the largest and longest-living tortoises on the planet, weighing more than 400 kilograms, occasionally exceeding 1.8 metres in length and living for more than a century.
sentences.zh: 在没有重大捕食者的情况下,它们成长为地球上最大、寿命最长的陆龟,体重超过400公斤,长度有时超过1.8米,寿命超过一个世纪。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B. Before human arrival, the archipelago's tortoises numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
sentences.zh: B. 在人类到来之前,群岛上的陆龟数量有数十万只。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: From the 17th century onwards, pirates took a few on board for 60 food, but the arrival of whaling ships in the 1790s saw this exploitation grow exponentially.
sentences.zh: 从 17 世纪开始,海盗以 60 份食物的价格带走一些人,但 1790 年代捕鲸船的到来使得这种剥削呈指数级增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Relatively immobile and capable of surviving for months without food or water, the tortoises were taken on board these ships to act as food supplies during long ocean passages.
sentences.zh: 陆龟相对不动,能够在没有食物和水的情况下生存数月,因此被带到这些船上,在漫长的海洋航行中充当食物供应。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sometimes, their bodies were processed into high grade oil.
sentences.zh: 有时,他们的尸体会被加工成高级油。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In total, an estimated 200,000 animals were taken from the archipelago before the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 20 世纪之前,估计总共有 200,000 只动物从群岛被捕获。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This historical exploitation was then exacerbated when settlers came to the islands.
sentences.zh: 当定居者来到这些岛屿时,这种历史性的剥削进一步加剧。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They hunted the tortoises and destroyed their habitat to clear land for agriculture.
sentences.zh: 他们猎杀乌龟并破坏它们的栖息地以清理土地用于农业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They also introduced alien species - ranging from cattle, pigs, goats, rats and dogs to plants and ants-that either prey on the eggs and young tortoises or damage or destroy their habitat.
sentences.zh: 他们还引入了外来物种——从牛、猪、山羊、老鼠和狗到植物和蚂蚁——它们要么捕食蛋和幼龟,要么破坏或破坏它们的栖息地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C. Today, only 11 of the original subspecies survive and of these, several are highly endangered.
sentences.zh: C. 如今,只有 11 个原始亚种幸存,其中有几个处于高度濒危状态。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In 1989, work began on a tortoise-breeding centre just outside the town of Puerto Villamil on Isabela, dedicated to protecting the island's tortoise populations.
sentences.zh: 1989 年,伊莎贝拉岛 Villamil 港镇外的陆龟养殖中心开始动工,致力于保护岛上的陆龟种群。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The centre's captive-breeding programme proved to be extremely successful, and it eventually had to deal with an overpopulation problem.
sentences.zh: 该中心的圈养繁殖计划被证明是非常成功的,它最终不得不解决人口过剩的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D. The problem was also a pressing one.
sentences.zh: D. 这个问题也是一个紧迫的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Captive-bred tortoises can't be reintroduced into the wild until they're at least five years old and weigh at least 4.5 kilograms, at which point their size and weight - and their hardened shells - are sufficient to protect them from predators.
sentences.zh: 圈养陆龟必须年满 5 岁且体重至少 4.5 公斤,才能被重新引入野外,此时它们的大小和重量以及坚硬的外壳足以保护它们免受捕食者的侵害。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But if people wait too long after that point, the tortoises eventually become too large to transport.
sentences.zh: 但如果人们在那之后等待太久,乌龟最终会变得太大而无法运输。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E. For years, repatriation efforts were carried out in small numbers, with the tortoises carried on the backs of men over weeks of long, treacherous hikes along narrow trails.
sentences.zh: E. 多年来,遣返工作都是小规模进行,人们将乌龟背在背上,沿着狭窄的小路进行数周的漫长而危险的徒步旅行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But in November 2010, the environmentalist and Galápagos National Park liaison officer Godfrey Merlin, a visiting private motor yacht captain and a helicopter pilot gathered around a table in a small café in Puerto Ayora on the island of Santa Cruz to work out more ambitious reintroduction.
sentences.zh: 但在 2010 年 11 月,环保人士兼加拉帕戈斯国家公园联络官戈弗雷·梅林 (Godfrey Merlin)、来访的私人机动游艇船长和直升机飞行员聚集在圣克鲁斯岛阿约拉港一家小咖啡馆的桌子旁,商讨更雄心勃勃的重新引入计划。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The aim was to use a helicopter to move 300 of the breeding centre's tortoises to various locations close to Sierra Negra.
sentences.zh: 目的是使用直升机将繁殖中心的 300 只陆龟转移到内格拉山脉附近的各个地点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F. This unprecedented effort was made possible by the owners of the 67-metre yacht White Cloud, who provided the Galápagos National Park with free use of their helicopter and its experienced pilot, as well as the logistical support of the yacht, its captain and crew.
sentences.zh: F. 这项史无前例的努力是由 67 米长的游艇 White Cloud 的船主促成的,他们为加拉帕戈斯国家公园提供了免费使用的直升机和经验丰富的飞行员,以及游艇、船长和船员的后勤支持。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Originally an air ambulance, the yacht's helicopter has a rear double door and a large internal space that's well suited for cargo, so a custom crate was designed to hold up to 33 tortoises with a total weight of about 150 kilograms.
sentences.zh: 游艇的直升机原本是一架空中救护车,后部有双门,内部空间很大,非常适合装货物,因此设计了一个定制板条箱,最多可容纳 33 只乌龟,总重约 150 公斤。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This weight, together with that of the fuel, pilot and four crew, approached the helicopter's maximum payload, and there were times when it was clearly right on the edge of the helicopter's capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这个重量,加上燃料、飞行员和四名机组人员的重量,接近直升机的最大有效载荷,有时它显然处于直升机能力的边缘。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: During a period of three days, group of volunteers from the breeding centre worked around the clock to prepare the young tortoises for transport.
sentences.zh: 在三天的时间里,繁育中心的志愿者们夜以继日地工作,为幼龟的运输做好准备。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, park wardens, dropped off ahead of time in remote locations, cleared landing sites within the thick brush, cacti and lava rocks.
sentences.zh: 与此同时,公园管理员提前在偏远地区下车,清理了茂密的灌木丛、仙人掌和熔岩中的着陆点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: G. Upon their release, the juvenile tortoises quickly spread out over their ancestral territory, investigating their new surroundings and feeding on the vegetation.
sentences.zh: G. 被释放后,幼年陆龟迅速散布到它们祖先的领地上,调查它们的新环境并以植被为食。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Eventually, one tiny tortoise came across a fully grown giant who had been lumbering around the island for around a hundred years.
sentences.zh: 最终,一只小乌龟遇到了一只已经在岛上缓慢行走了大约一百年的成年巨人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The two stood side by side, a powerful symbol of the regeneration of an ancient species.
sentences.zh: 两人并肩而立,这是一个古老物种再生的有力象征。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。
